config.detail: NeMo .nemo archive only (nemotron-labs-unified-asr-0.6b.nemo, 2,507,735,040 bytes, sha256 1718cc1b44fb8597b2356328d706a8d89f31c389ca6f2256c2e3f743c0246936). Values below were read from model_config.yaml inside the archive.

preprocessor.detail: Inside .nemo. Identical to parakeet-unified-en-0.6b: features=128, n_fft=512, window_size=0.025, window_stride=0.01, hann, normalize=per_feature, dither=1e-5, pad_to=0, no preemph key (NeMo default 0.97).

tokenizer_config.detail: SentencePiece BPE inside .nemo: 4095 pieces, blank id 4095, unk id 0, no BOS/EOS, byte_fallback false. One shared vocabulary for 25 languages (Latin, Cyrillic, Greek) with punctuation and case. No <lang-XX> tag pieces.

model_card.detail: Multilingual (25 European languages) unified offline + buffered-streaming RNN-T with a language prompt input. License OpenMDW-1.1.

reference_modeling_code.detail: No new layer types. Encoder / predictor / joint tensors have the names and shapes of parakeet-unified-en-0.6b except the three that depend on vocabulary size; the four prompt_kernel.* tensors have the shapes nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-0.6b already loads.

key_fields.encoder.type: Unified FastConformer (offline + buffered streaming, shared weights)
key_fields.prompt.injection: after the encoder, per frame: Linear(1024+128 -> 2048), ReLU, Linear(2048 -> 1024); output feeds the joint

dtype.evidence: NeMo .nemo, PyTorch state_dict at float32 by family convention.

reference_rationale: NVIDIA NeMo is the first-party framework and the only implementation of EncDecRNNTBPEModelWithPrompt and of the buffered chunked_limited_with_rc inference loop.
known_risks: Before this port, emit_buffered_chunk built the prompt MLP but never uploaded the language one-hot (fixed with the port). On the jfk clip a missing or wrong prompt left the transcript unchanged, so the prompt path needs tensor-level checks (scripts/validate_buffered_streaming.py --language).

The public API gates language hints on general.languages (the 25 short codes). The prompt dictionary also has locale keys that select different trained slots (es -> 3, es-ES -> 2; pt vs pt-BR); those are not reachable.
No language tag pieces: with language=NULL the model uses the 'auto' slot (127) and transcribes, but cannot report the language. stt.capability.lang_detect is false.
The model card's 0.56 s row uses R=5, which is outside the trained menu the runtime enforces; use (70,2,4) or (70,7,7).
4095-piece multilingual vocabulary: English words split into more pieces than with the 1024-piece English vocabulary, so more decoder steps and longer vocabulary-bias paths.
Offline is one full-attention pass (no VAD head, so no long-form chunking); memory grows with the square of the audio length.

intake_gaps.reason: Model-card numbers not transcribed here; no WER was measured for this port yet.
